# sonarqube_qualityprofile_deactivate_rule (Resource)

Ensures a rule is not active in a quality profile, e.g. one a parent profile would activate. Destroying it activates the rule again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sonarqube_qualityprofile" "base" {
  name     = "Company Java"
  language = "java"
  parent   = "Sonar way core" # built-in profile names vary by SonarQube version
}

resource "sonarqube_qualityprofile" "legacy" {
  name     = "Company Java legacy"
  language = "java"
  parent   = sonarqube_qualityprofile.base.name
}

# Turns off, in the child profile only, a rule it inherits from its parent.
resource "sonarqube_qualityprofile_deactivate_rule" "no_todo" {
  key  = sonarqube_qualityprofile.legacy.key
  rule = "java:S1135"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Quality profile key.
- `rule` (String) Rule key.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this resource in Terraform state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_qualityprofile_deactivate_rule.example 'AY1234567890abcdef/java:S1135'
```
